meta.name: Fully Open Humanoid
meta.frame: X forward, Y left, Z up; ground at z = 0

3DP_kit03_coupler.name: RS03 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit03_coupler.notes: Bolts to the RS03 output boss: 6 x M4 counterbored on PCD 30.36 with 3 x Ø4 dowel holes. Ø45 hub carries the 6809 support bearing; 4 x M4 heat-set inserts on a 32 mm PCD in the hub face take the next part. Print in PA-CF if PETG-CF creeps.

3DP_kit06_coupler.name: RS06 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit06_coupler.notes: 6 x M4 counterbored on PCD 24 with 3 x Ø4 dowel holes; Ø35 hub for the 6807 bearing; 4 x M4 inserts on a 26 mm PCD.

3DP_kit02_coupler.name: RS02 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit02_coupler.notes: 6 x M4 counterbored on PCD 24 with 3 x Ø4 dowel holes; Ø35 hub for the 6707 bearing; 4 x M4 inserts on a 26 mm PCD.

3DP_kit05_adapter.name: RS05 output adapter
3DP_kit05_adapter.notes: Ø44 x 5 disc: 6 x M4 counterbored on PCD 24 into the RS05 output, 4 x M3 inserts on a 30 mm square for the gripper. No support bearing at the wrist.

3DP_pel01_pelvis_shell.name: Pelvis shell
3DP_pel01_pelvis_shell.notes: One print: box shell, the two RS03 hip-pitch mount rings (8 x M4 on PCD 98, 6809 pocket) on its sides, the waist mount ring on top. 145 x 130 x 190 mm; needs a 250 mm bed.

3DP_leg02_hip_roll_bracket.name: Hip-roll bracket
3DP_leg02_hip_roll_bracket.notes: Plate on the hip-pitch coupler, web to the hip-roll RS03 mount: mount ring, sleeve, three straps and back plate, open on the inboard side.

3DP_leg04_hip_yaw_housing.name: Hip-yaw housing
3DP_leg04_hip_yaw_housing.notes: Front plate on the hip-roll coupler, RS03 mount ring and collar for the hip-yaw actuator (axis vertical, output down).

3DP_leg05_thigh_block.name: Thigh block with knee mount
3DP_leg05_thigh_block.notes: Plate on the hip-yaw coupler; full RS03 cup for the knee: mount ring, collar, back plate and Ø35 stub for the inner shank plate's bearing.

3DP_leg06_shank_outer_plate.name: Shank plate, outer (driven)
3DP_leg06_shank_outer_plate.notes: Bolts to the knee coupler; its lower end is the ankle-pitch RS03 mount ring (8 x M4 on PCD 98, 6809 pocket).

3DP_leg07_shank_inner_plate.name: Shank plate, inner (support)
3DP_leg07_shank_inner_plate.notes: Rides on the 6707 bearing on the thigh block's stub; free at the ankle.

3DP_leg08_shank_cross.name: Shank cross member
3DP_leg08_shank_cross.notes: Ties the two shank plates together above the ankle-pitch actuator; loom slots for the leg harness.

3DP_leg10_ankle_bracket.name: Ankle bracket
3DP_leg10_ankle_bracket.notes: Plate on the ankle-pitch coupler; RS06 mount ring, collar and back plate for the ankle-roll actuator behind the shank.

3DP_leg11_foot_bracket.name: Foot bracket
3DP_leg11_foot_bracket.notes: Upright on the ankle-roll coupler, base flange with 4 x M5 to the foot plate.

3DP_tor02_bottom_plate.name: Torso bottom plate
3DP_tor02_bottom_plate.notes: Bolts to the waist coupler (4 x M4 on PCD 32) and to the four 2020 uprights (M5 into tapped ends).

3DP_tor04_shoulder_mount.name: Shoulder-pitch mount
3DP_tor04_shoulder_mount.notes: RS06 mount ring, collar and back plate hung from the top plate; the ring's front face is flush with the torso side.

3DP_tor05_side_panel.name: Torso side panel
3DP_tor05_side_panel.notes: Cosmetic; 4 mm, with a clearance hole for the shoulder-pitch coupler.

3DP_tor06_back_panel.name: Torso back panel
3DP_tor06_back_panel.notes: Carries the E-stop and the main breaker.

3DP_tor08_electronics_tray.name: Electronics tray
3DP_tor08_electronics_tray.notes: Mounts the computer, CAN adapters, hub and power parts inside the frame.

3DP_tor09_battery_cradle.name: Battery cradle
3DP_tor09_battery_cradle.notes: One per pack; straps the pack to the rear of the frame.

3DP_hea02_head_shell.name: Head shell
3DP_hea02_head_shell.notes: Blank head with a RealSense mounting pocket. Camera is optional.

3DP_arm02_shoulder_bracket.name: Shoulder-roll bracket
3DP_arm02_shoulder_bracket.notes: Plate on the shoulder-pitch coupler, 64 mm beam outboard, full RS06 cup (mount ring, collar, back plate) for the shoulder-roll actuator.

3DP_arm04_upper_arm_yoke.name: Upper-arm yoke
3DP_arm04_upper_arm_yoke.notes: Front plate on the shoulder-roll coupler, shelf under the roll actuator, RS02 mount ring and collar for the shoulder-yaw actuator (output down).

3DP_arm06_upper_arm.name: Upper-arm link with elbow mount
3DP_arm06_upper_arm.notes: Plate on the shoulder-yaw coupler; full RS02 cup for the elbow with the Ø35 stub for the inner forearm plate.

3DP_arm09_forearm_inner.name: Forearm plate, inner (support)
3DP_arm09_forearm_inner.notes: Rides on the 6707 bearing on the upper arm's stub.

3DP_arm10_forearm_body.name: Forearm body with wrist mount
3DP_arm10_forearm_body.notes: Joins both forearm plates; bore and rear pattern (4 x M3 on PCD 38.5) hold the wrist-roll RS05.

3DP_grp01_gripper_body.name: Gripper body
3DP_grp01_gripper_body.notes: Rack-and-pinion parallel gripper after Duke V2; one STS3215 bus servo. Optional kit.

HW_6809_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6809-2RS, 45 x 58 x 7 mm
HW_6809_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS03 joint, on the coupler hub.

HW_6807_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6807-2RS, 35 x 47 x 7 mm
HW_6807_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS06 joint.

HW_6707_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6707-2RS, 35 x 44 x 5 mm
HW_6707_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS02 joint, and the inner-plate support bearing at the knees and elbows.

HW_2020_400.name: Aluminium 2020 extrusion, 400 mm, ends tapped M5
HW_2020_400.notes: Torso uprights. Cut to length or order pre-cut.

EL_PC_N100.name: Mini PC, Intel N100, 16 GB RAM, 500 GB SSD
EL_PC_N100.notes: Runs the 50 Hz policy and the 500 Hz motor loop. No GPU needed on the robot.

EL_BATTERY_6S.name: LiPo 6S 8000 mAh 100C, EC5
EL_BATTERY_6S.notes: Two in series: 44.4 V nominal, 50.4 V full. Zeee or equivalent.

EL_BUCK_12V.name: 48 V to 12 V buck converter, 10 A, encased
EL_BUCK_12V.notes: Feeds the computer, the hub and the gripper servos.

EL_DIST_BLOCK.name: Power distribution block with 60 A fuse
EL_DIST_BLOCK.notes: 48 V bus and ground bars; ANL/MIDI fuse on the pack lead.

EL_IMU.name: USB 9-axis AHRS IMU (SYD Dynamics TM171 or equivalent)
EL_IMU.notes: Mounted rigidly to the torso bottom plate, axes aligned with the base frame.

EL_ESTOP.name: E-stop, 22 mm mushroom, NC contact
EL_ESTOP.notes: Opens the 48 V bus contactor coil. Duke V2 shipped without one; do not.

EL_BREAKER.name: DC circuit breaker, 100 A, panel mount
EL_BREAKER.notes: Main disconnect and pack over-current protection.

EL_CONTACTOR.name: DC contactor, 100 A, 12 V coil
EL_CONTACTOR.notes: Switched by the E-stop loop; carries the motor bus.

EL_CAMERA_D435I.name: Intel RealSense D435i
EL_CAMERA_D435I.notes: Optional perception kit. Any USB camera fits the head pocket with an adapter.

EL_SERVO_STS3215.name: Feetech STS3215 bus servo, 12 V
EL_SERVO_STS3215.notes: One per gripper; both on one Waveshare bus driver.

ACT_RS03.name: RobStride RS03 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS03.notes: 60 N·m peak, 20 N·m rated, Ø98 x 56.6 mm, 880 g. Mounts by 8 x M4 on PCD 98; output 6 x M4 on PCD 30.36.

ACT_RS06.name: RobStride RS06 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS06.notes: 36 N·m peak, 11 N·m rated, Ø84.5 x 49 mm, 621 g. Mounts by 8 x M3 on PCD 88; output 6 x M4 on PCD 24.

ACT_RS02.name: RobStride RS02 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS02.notes: 17 N·m peak, 6 N·m rated, Ø65 x 41.5 mm, 405 g. Mounts by 9 x M3 on PCD 73; output 6 x M4 on PCD 24.

ACT_RS05.name: RobStride RS05 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS05.notes: 5.5 N·m peak, 1.6 N·m rated, Ø46 x 44 mm, 191 g. Mounts by 8 x M3 on PCD 41.5; output 6 x M4 on PCD 24.
